name: Kremlin Blocks
author: Cyberdelia
help: Turn the wheel to move a falling block. Prev rotates left, Next rotates right. Select drops it at once; hold Play to drop it faster. Complete horizontal rows to clear them. Three ways to play: Marathon (faster every ten rows, to level 20), Sprint (forty rows as fast as you can) and Blitz (the most points in two minutes). The city round the well changes as you go: Red Square, winter, sunset, white nights and the night sky. Menu pauses. Your own music keeps playing.

achievements.text: Reach the night sky in Marathon.
